user_question: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospitals to census tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform hospital point geometries from EPSG:4326 into the census tracts' EPSG:26918 CRS so the spatial join uses compatible coordinate systems.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the input hospital vector layer to EPSG:26918 and preserve its hospital attributes and valid point geometries.

workflow_steps.title: Assign hospitals to containing census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Perform a point-in-polygon spatial join so each hospital receives the identifier of the census tract containing it.
workflow_steps.instructions: Spatially join the projected hospital points to the census tract polygons using containment. Preserve every hospital record and append the tract identifier attribute from the containing polygon; ground the actual identifier field from runtime schema evidence rather than guessing a field name.

requirements.scope: The hospital and census tract inputs to the spatial join must use compatible coordinate reference systems.
The census tract input must contain a field that identifies each tract, and that field must be transferred to the hospital output.
